messages:
ana: quick q — should operator accept full AdmitIntent or just a compact AdmitToken? trying to reduce surface area. :thinking_face:

dmitri: compact AdmitToken. operator stays simple; control-plane owns policy.

sam_k: compact + must include request_id and tenant_id for tracing.

lee: operator needs priority hint and preemptible boolean so local eviction matches global QoS.

maria: proposed response: admit_token, estimated_warmup_ms, node_hint (opt), priority_enum (latency|best_effort|burst), soft_reservation_id (opt).

chris: HTTP sketch:
POST /v1/operator/admit
Body {"request_id":"r123","tenant_id":"t-42","slots":2,"ttl_seconds":300}
200 {"admit_token":"tok-xyz","estimated_warmup_ms":1200,"node_hint":"rack-3","priority":"latency","soft_reservation":"sr-1"}
429 {"reason":"capacity","retry_after_seconds":45}

ana: failure modes — if operator returns admit_token but OOMs during warmup operator must emit admission_failure with request_id+token; control-plane should retry or fallback to hosted variant.

lee: eviction: operator should try graceful drain in an eviction_safe_window (~10s) and expose /v1/operator/eviction webhook for audit.

sam_k: telemetry: metrics must include request_id, tenant_id, admit_token, warmup_duration_ms, eviction_reason.

maria: control-plane needs Revoke API: {admit_token, request_id, revoke_reason, grace_seconds}; operator returns ack + drained_seconds.

chris: noted. ops: helm chart v2.3 has /admit but no Revoke handler (ticket INF-1982).

ana: action items: 1) lock Admit/Response schema + enum values, 2) publish telemetry contract, 3) add Revoke proto, 4) implement chaos test for admit-then-oom. I'll draft a short RFC.

dmitri: add a small seq diagram to the RFC showing admit -> warmup -> admission_failure -> fallback. helps clarify races.

sam_k: I'll draft diagram + telemetry table. maria can pick revoke reason codes. :thumbsup:

maria: can do. target RFC draft by EOD tomorrow?

ana: EOD works, thanks.
